description_en: Invoke the DeleteRegistrantProfile API to delete a specified domain name registrant profile.
description_zh: 调用DeleteRegistrantProfile接口删除指定的域名信息模板
name: DeleteRegistrantProfile

parameters.help_en: The User IP address. You can set it to 127.0.0.1.
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message returned by the API. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese.  
en: English.  

Default value: en.
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name registrant profile to delete. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html API to query the profile ID.
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的信息模板的编号。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html接口查询信息模板编号
parameters.name: registrant_profile_id
